title: Running & Flying Motion Verbs
grammarPoint: Motion verb triads for running (biegać/biec/pobiec) and flying (latać/lecieć/polecieć) — plus other movement verbs: pływać/płynąć, wozić/wieźć/zawieźć

explanation.text:
The same multidirectional/unidirectional/perfective pattern extends to all motion verbs.

## Running Verbs

| Verb | Type | Meaning |
|------|------|---------|
| **biegać** | multidirectional | to run (habitually/in various directions) |
| **biec** | unidirectional | to run (right now, in one direction) |
| **pobiec** | perfective | to run (once, to a destination) |

- Codziennie **biegam** rano. (I run every morning — habit)
- **Biegnę** na autobus! (I'm running for the bus — right now!)
- **Pobiegłam** do sklepu. (I ran to the shop — once)

## Flying Verbs

| Verb | Type | Meaning |
|------|------|---------|
| **latać** | multidirectional | to fly (habitually, in various directions) |
| **lecieć** | unidirectional | to fly (right now, ongoing) |
| **polecieć** | perfective | to fly (once, to a destination) |

- Często **latam** do Londynu. (I often fly to London — habit)
- **Lecę** do Berlina. (I'm flying to Berlin — right now, on the way)
- **Poleciałam** do Paryża w maju. (I flew to Paris in May — one trip)

## Swimming Verbs

| Verb | Type | Meaning |
|------|------|---------|
| **pływać** | multidirectional | to swim (habit) / to sail |
| **płynąć** | unidirectional | to swim/sail right now |
| **popłynąć** | perfective | to set off swimming/sailing |

## Carrying/Transporting Verbs

| Verb | Type | Meaning |
|------|------|---------|
| **wozić** | multidirectional | to transport habitually (by vehicle) |
| **wieźć** | unidirectional | to be transporting right now |
| **zawieźć** | perfective | to transport (to a destination, once) |

- **Wożę** dzieci do szkoły. (I take the kids to school — daily habit)
- **Wiozę** pacjentów do szpitala. (I'm taking patients to hospital — now)
- **Zawiozłem** mamę na lotnisko. (I took mum to the airport — once)
notes: Biec (pres): biegnę, biegniesz, biegnie, biegniemy, biegniecie, biegną.
Lecieć (pres): lecę, lecisz, leci, lecimy, lecicie, lecą.
Pływać vs płynąć: key distinction for both swimming and boat/ship travel.
All these triads follow the same rule: -ać = habit/multi; root form = right now/one direction; po-/za- prefix = perfective.

explanation_fa: الگوی یکسانی برای همه افعال حرکتی: biegać (دویدن تکراری/چندجهته): Biegam co rano (هر صبح می‌دوم). biec (دویدن یک‌جهته): Biegnę na autobus (دارم برای اتوبوس می‌دوم). pobiec (کامل): Pobiegłem do lekarza (رفتم دکتر — دویدم). latać/lecieć/polecieć برای پرواز.

exercises.prompt: Uwaga! Spóźnię się! ___ na autobus! (I'm running for the bus right now!)
exercises.explanation: 'Biegnę!' = I'm running right now (unidirectional, biec). Urgent ongoing action. 'Biegam' = I run habitually. 'Pobiegłem' = past perfective (I ran — done). Use unidirectional for 'happening right now'.

exercises.prompt: Często ___ do Londynu w celach służbowych. (I often fly to London for business.)
exercises.explanation: 'Latam' = I fly habitually (latać, multidirectional). 'Lecę' = I'm flying right now. 'Poleciałam' = I flew (once, past perf). 'Często' = often → habit signal → multidirectional 'latam'.

options: W lecie pływam w jeziorze prawie codziennie.
W lecie płynę przez jezioro prawie codziennie.
W lecie popłynęłam do jeziora prawie codziennie.
W lecie pływałam w jeziorze co tydzień.
exercises.explanation: You heard: 'W lecie pływam w jeziorze prawie codziennie.' — In summer I swim in the lake almost every day. 'Pływam' = multidirectional habitual (swim regularly). 'Prawie codziennie' = almost every day (habit signal). 'W jeziorze' = in the lake (locative).

exercises.prompt: Codziennie ___ dzieci do szkoły. (Every day I take the kids to school by car.)
exercises.explanation: 'Wożę' = I transport habitually (wozić, multidirectional). 'Wiozę' = I'm transporting right now (wieźć, unidirectional). 'Zawiozłem' = I took (once, past perf). 'Codziennie wożę' = every day I take — habitual transport.

exercises.prompt: Build: Last year I flew to Japan for the first time. (polecieć, perfective past)
exercises.explanation: 'W zeszłym roku poleciałem/poleciałam do Japonii po raz pierwszy.' — Last year I flew to Japan for the first time. 'Poleciałem/poleciałam' = perfective past (one trip). 'Do Japonii' = to Japan (genitive). 'Po raz pierwszy' = for the first time (fixed phrase).
